verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਡਾ ਪੈਸਾ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kauddaa paisaa rupieeaa sunieeaa ko banaj karai ratan paarakh hoi jauharee kahaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as one starts dealing in shells in the beginning, then in money, gold coins and then becomes evaluator of diamonds and precious stones. He is then called a jeweller.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਉਡਾ ਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੈ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਮੈ ਪਤਸਿਟਾ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jauharee kahai pun kauddaa ko banaj karai pa(n)ch paravaan mai patasiTaa ghaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: But after becoming famous as a jeweller, one starts dealing in shells, he loses his respect among the elite people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਊਚ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aan dhev sev gurdhev ko sevak hui lok paralok bikhai uooch padh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Similarly, if a follower of some god comes into the service of True Guru, he acquires high status in this and the world beyond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਪੂਤ ਹੁਇ ਹਸਾਵਈ ॥੪੭੯॥
verses.translit_en: chhaadd gurdhev sev aan dhev sevak hui nihafal janam kapoot hui hasaaviee ||479||

en.bdb: But if someone leaves the service of the True Guru, and becomes a follower of some other god, then he wastes away his human life and he is laughed at by others being known as a bad son.  (479)
